lines.en: The sun is cruel; I look for shade.

lines.zh: 沙丘这么多，我该往哪走。
lines.en: So many dunes, which way was I going?

lines.zh: 沙丘那头，有活人的气息。
lines.en: Living breath, past the dunes.
I climb the dune's slope slowly.

lines.zh: 我的脚陷进沙里，又拔出来。
lines.en: My feet sink into the sand and pull free again.
The sand burns my feet; I do not mind.
I walk toward those ruins.
woods... I can't go back.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在沙里，慢慢挪。
lines.en: My bones shift slowly through the sand.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙脊走，避开日光。
lines.en: I walk the sand ridge, keeping out of the sun.

lines.zh: 沙丘的坡上，我的长影跟着滑。
lines.en: On the dune slope my long shadow slides along with me.

lines.zh: 沙漠里风大，我骨头却干。
lines.en: The desert wind is loud; my bones are dry.
My shadow shrinks to my feet.
Sand fills this husk frame.
I count the dunes: one, two.

lines.zh: 沙漠太安静了，连风都干。
lines.en: The desert's too quiet — even the wind is dry.

lines.zh: 我记得自己要射箭，忘了射谁。
lines.en: I remember shooting; I forget at whom.

lines.zh: 风把我的沙子吹走一层。
lines.en: The wind blows a layer of sand off me.
Still holding my bones.

lines.zh: 沙把我的胸腔填了一半。
lines.en: Sand has filled half of my chest cavity.
Breathing? Long unnecessary.

lines.zh: 沙漠的干风，把我的骨头吹白了。
lines.en: The dry desert wind has bleached my bones.

lines.zh: 你喝过水，喉咙里还有湿气。
lines.en: You have drunk water; your throat still holds the damp.

lines.zh: 我活着的时候，也这样看你。
lines.en: When I was alive, I looked at people like this too.

lines.zh: 沙漠的尸壳，晒成了这副骨。
lines.en: A desert husk baked down to these bones.

lines.zh: 骨头听不见心跳，可我记得。
lines.en: Bones can't hear hearts, but I remember.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，隔着沙也听得见。
lines.en: Through the sand, I can hear your heart.

lines.zh: 你腰上的水袋，让我想起渴。
lines.en: The waterskin at your belt reminds me of thirst.

lines.zh: 沙漠里我的嘴，只剩一个洞。
lines.en: In the desert my mouth is only a hole.

lines.zh: 你呼出的气是白的，真暖。
lines.en: Your breath comes out white and warm.
They call me Hollow. Remember.

lines.zh: 沙漠里好久没见过这么红的脸。
lines.en: I have not seen such a red face in the desert.

lines.zh: 骨屑落进沙里，我数着还剩几根。
lines.en: Bone dust falls into the sand; I count what is left.
My bones rattle in the sand...
Fine sand works into my joints.
Don't touch that wound.

lines.zh: 沙漠的风，吹得我骨头响。
lines.en: Desert wind rattles my bones.

lines.zh: 我这副干骨架，还撑得住。
lines.en: This dried frame of mine still holds.
Only bones still walk the desert.
Sand pours out of the wound.

lines.zh: 没有眼窝的眼睛，也在看你。
lines.en: Even eyeless sockets watch you.
Pain, so I can still feel pain.

lines.zh: 那股味道，让我的下颌发酸。
lines.en: That smell makes my jaw ache.
That is meat, still bloody.
One bite will do; I am not picky.
This was never supposed to be my want.
Sand in my mouth doesn't feed me.
Dry sand is packed inside my bones.
Can this be eaten... probably.

lines.zh: 你不用藏，烂味顺着沙缝过来。
lines.en: No need to hide it; the stink slips through the sand.
A husk's bones are drier than the sand.
Sand-filled lungs take no air.

lines.zh: 我的肩胛骨碰到你的盾。
lines.en: My shoulder blade knocks against your shield.

lines.zh: 我的脚骨被你踩进沙里。
lines.en: You press my foot bones into the sand.

lines.zh: 我让开了，骨头却还在响。
lines.en: I step aside, but my bones keep rattling.
My kneecap clicked once.

lines.zh: 尸壳的骨头，晒了太多太阳。
lines.en: A husk's bones have baked too long.
My shoulder came off. I put it back.
What you hit is bone.

lines.zh: 沙漠的风干了我，肉都没了。
lines.en: Desert wind dried me hollow.
I nearly come apart into a pile of bones.
You knock the sand off my shoulders.
Our finger bones touch once.

lines.zh: 我记不起生前拥抱过谁。
lines.en: I cannot recall whom I held while I was alive.

lines.zh: 我早忘了该怎么靠近谁。
lines.en: I forgot long ago how to come near anyone.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，听沙子响。
lines.en: We stand side by side, listening to the sand.

lines.zh: 亡者抱在一起，也不会暖。
lines.en: The dead embracing still stay cold.
Desert bones bleach pale in the sun.
Only bones are left of my fingers.
In this desert we cannot dig a grave.

lines.zh: 靠近一点，我身上全是沙。
lines.en: Come closer: I am covered in sand.
I heap the sand into two small mounds.
I tuck it inside my chest.
This little bell will not ring for me.
Take it back and bury it in the sand.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，脊柱咔了一声。
lines.en: I bend over; my spine clicks.
My finger bones cannot pinch it.

lines.zh: 我的手指僵，抓不住东西。
lines.en: My fingers are stiff and cannot grip.

lines.zh: 我是尸壳剩下的那副骨头。
lines.en: I am what the husk left behind.
Whatever the sand buries is mine.
I tuck it between my ribs.
I held a blade like this when I was alive.

lines.zh: 沙漠的干风，把我的皮吹干了。
lines.en: The desert wind dried out my skin.

lines.zh: 沙漠的空壳，叫住了生者。
lines.en: A desert husk calls the living to stop.

lines.zh: 我隔着沙丘，先看你一眼。
lines.en: From beyond the dune, I take one look at you.
The sand behind you shifts once.
My arrowhead lines up with your back.

lines.zh: 沙底下躺太久，才等到你。
lines.en: Too long under the sand, and then you came.
Under the sand, I am watching you.

lines.zh: 你踏进这片沙，我的眼窝就对准了。
lines.en: You step onto this sand, and my eye sockets fix on you.
I draw my bow behind the dune.
There is only you in my eye sockets.
Sand has filled the gaps in my bones.
My bones tell me you are over there.

lines.zh: 活人的味道，从沙里透过来。
lines.en: A living smell seeps up through the sand.
Out here, your heart is too loud.
My arrow is already nocked.

lines.zh: 沙漠的日头，把我晒成空壳。
lines.en: The desert sun baked me into a hollow shell.
The sand remembers your weight.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，因为没肉。
lines.en: My steps are light; there is no flesh left.

lines.zh: 影子跟着你，我的骨头也是。
lines.en: Shadow follows you, and so do my bones.
No water in this shell, only bone.
No road past the dunes.

lines.zh: 你留下的脚印，我一个一个踩。
lines.en: I step in your footprints, one by one.

lines.zh: 沙漠的白天，把我的骨晒干了。
lines.en: Desert days bake my bones dry.
Catch your breath. I'll wait.
The knuckles of my drawing hand go pale.

lines.zh: 我数着你的心跳，快追上弓弦了。
lines.en: I count your heartbeat; it is near my bowstring's pace.
Your steps ring loud on the sand.

lines.zh: 腿断了也追，沙漠里无处躲。
lines.en: Broken leg and still chasing; no cover in the sand.
I cannot pant, so I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 沙里没水，我的骨头干得响。
lines.en: No water in this sand — my bones rattle dry.
I can't even recall thirst.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖磨得只剩骨头。
lines.en: My knees are worn down to bone.
Run; the dunes have no end.
This punch takes all the strength I have.

lines.zh: 我等这副骨头再动一次。
lines.en: I have waited for these bones to move once more.
The sand slipped — my apologies.

lines.zh: 干透的拳头，让开别挡道。
lines.en: Dry fists — clear the way.
In the desert, do not shout so loud.
A dried fist comes down.

lines.zh: 我的骨头撞上你的膝盖。
lines.en: My bones crash against your knee.

lines.zh: 我出手的时候，想不起来。
lines.en: When I strike, I cannot remember.
All bone now — I move lighter.
My finger bones strike your face.

lines.zh: 干成这样的骨头，只剩挥的力气。
lines.en: Bones this dry have only swinging left.
Bone strikes bone, loudly.

lines.zh: 你退了，沙子替你挡了一下。
lines.en: You retreat, and the sand takes the blow.
A dried hand closes on you.

lines.zh: 这一拳，我自己也听见了。
lines.en: Even I heard that punch.

lines.zh: 我抬手的力气，都是从沙里借的。
lines.en: The strength to raise my arm is borrowed from the sand.

lines.zh: 这片沙漠，比我记得的干。
lines.en: This desert is drier than I remember.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘的背面站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the far side of the dune.
Do not come close; I am soaking up the sun.

lines.zh: 我的颌骨动了动，没有声音。
lines.en: My jaw moves, but no sound comes.

lines.zh: 我从沙里撑起这副架子。
lines.en: I push this frame up out of the sand.
The dune shifts, and I claw my way out.
This dried shell has no blood at all.

lines.zh: 沙漠的风，先吹进我的骨头。
lines.en: The desert wind blows into my bones first.

lines.zh: 太阳升起来，我站了起来。
lines.en: The sun rises, and I stand up.
The soil loosened, so I crawled out.

lines.zh: 夜里的沙子，比骨头还凉。
lines.en: Night sand is colder than bone.

lines.zh: 沙子从我的眼窝里漏出来。
lines.en: Sand leaks out of my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 我站在沙丘上，骨头里灌满沙。
lines.en: I stand on the dune, sand filling my bones.
Sand has filled my bones.
Where the fire passed, only ash remains.

lines.zh: 落下的时候，我数了三下。
lines.en: Falling, I counted three.
Water soaks into my bones and weighs them down.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪，把我吹散了半边。
lines.en: The blast scatters half of me away.
An arrow is lodged in my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 魔法烧得我的骨头吱吱响。
lines.en: Magic makes my bones creak as it burns.
The arrows I drop are all old ones.

lines.zh: 太阳一晒，我身上就冒烟。
lines.en: One touch of sun and I smoke.
In the void there is not even sand.
